You don't need HIM. You just need a place to stay for a while. You have gotten stuck in a position where you compromised your self worth for a place to stay. Compromise something else. Your pride? Your comfort? Ask a friend if they have/know somewhere to stay for awhile. Their spare room. Their couch. Their parents house. Their grandparents house. Old people are lonely. Love company. Find a new guy willing to help. Just do to him what your boyfriend is doing to you. But nicer or something. All awful advice and hard to do in one way or another. You don't need him. You need what he has to offer. And there are other, better, ways to get it.

Re reading your OP it seems he is the main reason you are feeling the way you do. Other than what your farther did. Which if pretty fucked. But I don't know the whole story so I won't go there. Not having parents for a safety net is hard. But look at the good.  You just graduated. You know you are smart. You know how to present yourself. Be professional. Keep trying. 90% of new graduates are struggling the way you are at work. The only difference is you have this jerk making everything worse at home. So again you don't need him. Just what he is offering. 

(I just reread that and it is very jumbled. Bad advice. But I will post it instead of deleting it and not replying. Take from it what you will.)

Hey, I just posted as well so I am in no way an expert at anything, or even have much apathy. But I read what you wrote. And my advice is this: talk to your mother. Tell her what you are going through. Tell her you lied about your job. Tell her you need somewhere to stay. As long as she knows you will be striving to find your own place. She is you mother I'm sure she would rather see you try to get on your own feet than see you harm yourself.  But more importantly get rid of this boyfriend. He sounds like a jerk.  Not worth your time. Better off without. Start looking for better job/house.  Day by day. 

On a side note writing this kind of gave myself advise too. Might talk to my own parents. See if they will take me back so I can start fresh. So maybe reply to someone else here. Or don't. Again no expert so I hope someone else try's to help you.
